posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Why so many messages in such a short space of time? Please use the edit button.
About your problem:
I provided the tools, unfortunately I don't have a Windows operating system in that language to test.
I recommend that you do as many tests as possible and list more than one available font so that it works for as many players as possible.
Example:
Ruby:
Font.default_name = ["Arial","Tahoma","Verdana"]
